deals.title: Koluxhome Tech VACTechPro 35kPa Cordless Stick Vacuum for $83 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This Koluxhome Tech cordless stick vacuum is $82.99, down from $599.99. It converts into a 6-in-1 handheld tool, runs up to 35 minutes per charge, and includes a washable HEPA filter that's rated to capture particles as small as 0.3 microns. Shipping is free. Offer ends October 13 at 2:59 AM ET. Buy Now at Wayfair Features 35kPa suction power with brushless motor Up to 35 minutes of runtime on eco mode, 15-18 minutes on max mode Converts into a 6-in-1 handheld vacuum with crevice tool and extension wand Removable, rechargeable battery that can charge on or off the unit Washable HEPA filtration that captures particles as small as 0.3 microns Weighs 7.15 lb. and includes a wall-mounted charging station
